query: The rainy weather this week has been so nice for staying in and baking, I just tried out a new matcha scone recipe yesterday and they turned out perfectly flaky, I even shared a few with my next-door neighbor who dropped off some homemade jam last month. Oh and I finally got around to watching that new cozy mystery show everyone’s been posting about, the plot twists are so unexpected I stayed up way too late binging the first three episodes last night. Also my cat just learned how to open the kitchen cabinet where we keep the treats, I had to put a child lock on it this morning because he kept sneaking in and eating half a bag of tuna treats when I wasn’t looking. Anyway, I need to process a return for my delivered order #W2378156, the items I want to return are 4602305039, 4202497723 and 9408160950, and I’d like the refund to go back to my payment method credit_card_9513926.
